newsitem.title: USA: Barney's gets full use of 110mln bankruptcy fund.
newsitem.headline: Barney's gets full use of 110mln bankruptcy fund.

text.p: Barney's, the embattled high fashion retailer was given Bankruptcy Court approval for the full use of a $110 million fund, known as a debtor-in-possession facility.

The company said it is allowed to run its operations under this facilty, which is being provided by a syndicate of creditors, led by BankBoston NA. This financing expires on August 3, 1998, the end of the company's 1998 fiscal year.

In a statement, the company said the enhanced availability and larger facility under the current DIP will provide comfort for its vendors and enable the company to operate according to its 1998 business plan.
Barney's, a privately held company, run by the Pressman family, filed for protection under chapter 11 bankruptcy rules on January 10, 1996.
